scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test:event-source-status:integration: sh -c 'test -n "$EVENT_SOURCE_STATUS_TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo "EVENT_SOURCE_STATUS_TEST_DATABASE_URL must point to an isolated test database" >&2; exit 1; }; DATABASE_URL="$EVENT_SOURCE_STATUS_TEST_DATABASE_URL" EVENT_SOURCE_STATUS_INTEGRATION=1 tsx --test src/routes/sources.test.ts'
scripts.test:saved-events:integration: sh -c 'test -n "$SAVED_EVENTS_TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo "SAVED_EVENTS_TEST_DATABASE_URL must point to an isolated test database" >&2; exit 1; }; DATABASE_URL="$SAVED_EVENTS_TEST_DATABASE_URL" pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && DATABASE_URL="$SAVED_EVENTS_TEST_DATABASE_URL" tsx --test src/routes/saved-events.test.ts'
scripts.test:listings-query:integration: sh -c 'test -n "$LISTINGS_TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo "LISTINGS_TEST_DATABASE_URL must point to an isolated test database" >&2; exit 1; }; DATABASE_URL="$LISTINGS_TEST_DATABASE_URL" pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && DATABASE_URL="$LISTINGS_TEST_DATABASE_URL" tsx --test src/routes/listings-query.integration.test.ts'
